items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Now this fellow, his name was Scott, but his first name, I don't have it.

ctx.x: That's Alonzo Tonnage. What does he play? I can't see. Is that? Trumpet. That's Trumpet. Oh, this one. The man in that. That's trombone. That's Adolph White. Adolph White? Adolph White, yeah. He used to work for Clown and Dairy. Now this fellow, his name was Scott, but his first name, I don't have it. Now this is Martin Gabriel. That's the one I tell you about, had the famous jazz band. He also had a famous jazz brass band. Right in front of the baritone horn? Yeah. Now that's a bass. Oh, is that a bass? Uh-huh.…
Must have been a small E-flat bass. Is that what it looks like?
